It is a reminder of the journey that every Muslim embarks on in their search for knowledge, self-improvement, and spiritual growth.

The name encourages the bearer to remain steadfast on the path of righteousness, to strive for excellence in all aspects of their life, and to always seek the pleasure of Allah. It is a constant reminder of the importance of faith, piety, and devotion in the quest for a meaningful and fulfilling life.
